dct_description_sm:
see also Gitwangak Band Squin-lix-stat Reserve, 1900_2024
(https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/RX4EO1)

Georeferenced map of Gitwangak Band reserves 1 and 2  on the Skeena River clipped from original Plan of the Kitwangar Indian Reserve, Cassiar District (https://doi.org/10.58066/m35h-2e65). Land cover and features include types of trees and soil, a mission, roads to Hazelton and Kitwancool, graves, and gardens.
